#====================================================================================================
# START - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# THIS SECTION CONTAINS CRITICAL TESTING INSTRUCTIONS FOR BOTH AGENTS
# BOTH MAIN_AGENT AND TESTING_AGENT MUST PRESERVE THIS ENTIRE BLOCK

# Communication Protocol:
# If the `testing_agent` is available, main agent should delegate all testing tasks to it.
#
# You have access to a file called `test_result.md`. This file contains the complete testing state
# and history, and is the primary means of communication between main and the testing agent.
#
# Main and testing agents must follow this exact format to maintain testing data. 
# The testing data must be entered in yaml format Below is the data structure:
# 
## user_problem_statement: {problem_statement}
## backend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.py"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## frontend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.js"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## metadata:
##   created_by: "main_agent"
##   version: "1.0"
##   test_sequence: 0
##   run_ui: false
##
## test_plan:
##   current_focus:
##     - "Task name 1"
##     - "Task name 2"
##   stuck_tasks:
##     - "Task name with persistent issues"
##   test_all: false
##   test_priority: "high_first"  # or "sequential" or "stuck_first"
##
## agent_communication:
##     -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##     -message: "Communication message between agents"

# Protocol Guidelines for Main agent
#
# 1. Update Test Result File Before Testing:
#    - Main agent must always update the `test_result.md` file before calling the testing agent
#    - Add implementation details to the status_history
#    - Set `needs_retesting` to true for tasks that need testing
#    - Update the `test_plan` section to guide testing priorities
#    - Add a message to `agent_communication` explaining what you've done
#
# 2. Incorporate User Feedback:
#    - When a user provides feedback that something is or isn't working, add this information to the relevant task's status_history
#    - Update the working status based on user feedback
#    - If a user reports an issue with a task that was marked as working, increment the stuck_count
#    - Whenever user reports issue in the app, if we have testing agent and task_result.md file so find the appropriate task for that and append in status_history of that task to contain the user concern and problem as well 
#
# 3. Track Stuck Tasks:
#    - Monitor which tasks have high stuck_count values or where you are fixing same issue again and again, analyze that when you read task_result.md
#    - For persistent issues, use websearch tool to find solutions
#    - Pay special attention to tasks in the stuck_tasks list
#    - When you fix an issue with a stuck task, don't reset the stuck_count until the testing agent confirms it's working
#
# 4. Provide Context to Testing Agent:
#    - When calling the testing agent, provide clear instructions about:
#      - Which tasks need testing (reference the test_plan)
#      - Any authentication details or configuration needed
#      - Specific test scenarios to focus on
#      - Any known issues or edge cases to verify
#
# 5. Call the testing agent with specific instructions referring to test_result.md
#
# IMPORTANT: Main agent must ALWAYS update test_result.md BEFORE calling the testing agent, as it relies on this file to understand what to test next.

#====================================================================================================
# END - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================



#====================================================================================================
# Testing Data - Main Agent and testing sub agent both should log testing data below this section
#====================================================================================================

PROBLEM: VerificationPage.jsx (/verification route) uses WRONG API endpoint - calls /api/verification/upload (role verification endpoint) instead of /api/kyc/submit (KYC endpoint). SYMPTOMS: (1) When user clicks submit button, API returns 400 Bad Request with error 'No role verification required' or 'Verification already submitted', (2) Frontend shows error message 'API is not defined', (3) No status update occurs - user sees upload form even when KYC status is already 'pending', (4) Appears to 'hang' because no proper error/success feedback is shown. This endpoint is for ROLE verification (merchant/influencer/manager/investor), NOT for KYC identity verification. The correct endpoint should be /api/kyc/submit. Additionally, VerificationPage doesn't check current KYC status before showing upload form - even users with kyc_status='pending' see the upload form and can attempt resubmission, which fails with 400 'KYC bereits eingereicht'. TESTING RESULTS: ✅ Backend KYC API (/api/kyc/submit) works correctly - tested with admin@bidblitz.com account, returns proper status (pending/approved/rejected) with AI confidence score. ✅ KYCFlow.jsx (4-stage wizard at /kyc route) uses CORRECT endpoint and works properly. ✅ File uploads work correctly (tested with small PNG images). ✅ Authentication works correctly. ❌ VerificationPage.jsx (/verification route) BROKEN - wrong API endpoint causes all submissions to fail. IMPACT: Users accessing /verification page cannot complete KYC submission. The page loads, files upload successfully (green checkmarks visible), but clicking submit fails silently or shows confusing error messages. This matches user's report: 'Prüfung startet nicht' - verification appears to start but never completes. WORKAROUND: Users can use /kyc route instead of /verification route - KYCFlow.jsx works correctly. REQUIRED FIXES: (1) Change VerificationPage.jsx line 54 from api.uploadVerification(fd) to use /api/kyc/submit endpoint, (2) Add KYC status check on page load - if kyc_status is 'pending' or 'approved', show status banner instead of upload form (lines 95-118 already have status banners but they're not being triggered because data structure is wrong), (3) Fix api.uploadVerification in services/api.js to call /api/kyc/submit instead of /api/verification/upload, OR create new api.submitKYC function, (4) Improve error handling to show user-friendly messages instead of 'API is not defined'. SCREENSHOTS: kyc_auth_files_uploaded.png shows upload form with green checkmarks (files uploaded successfully), kyc_auth_after_submit.png shows form after submit with no feedback (hanging state), kyc_auth_hung.png shows final state with no response after 30 seconds. API LOGS: Backend logs show 'POST /api/verification/upload HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request' when VerificationPage submits, confirming wrong endpoint is being called. RECOMMENDATION: Main agent should fix VerificationPage.jsx to use correct KYC endpoint (/api/kyc/submit) and add proper status checking. This is a HIGH PRIORITY bug affecting all users trying to complete KYC verification via /verification route. Test results saved to /root/.emergent/automation_output/20260607_184255/console_20260607_184255.log."
